model.title: Department of Homeland Security Intelligence and Analysis Training Act
model.meta: Homeland Security Committee · Rep. Seth Magaziner (D-RI)

summary.text: The bill would require the Department of Homeland Security's Office of Intelligence and Analysis to establish standardized training programs for new employees covering federal privacy rights, civil liberties, and information practices, with additional specialized training for those in analytical and intelligence collection roles. It would also direct the office to develop advanced training curricula, maintain a tracking system for employee training completion, and require a government audit of how these new training requirements compare to similar programs across the intelligence community and Department of Defense.
